enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over on the bed. Pull the blanket up. Keep the fan switched on at low speed. Sleep continuously through the night and into the morning. Turn over again. Remain lying on the bed. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup water in both hands. Rinse face. Pick up the towel. Wipe face dry. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the soap. Turn on the shower tap. Wash body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Dry hair. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with toast, kettle-boiled tea and fruit
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread, fruit and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the countertop. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to boil. Open the toaster slot. Place two slices of bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Place the plate on the countertop. Pick up a knife. Cut the fruit on the cutting board. Place the fruit pieces on the plate. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on the plate. Pour the boiled water into a cup. Add a tea bag to the cup. Stir the tea with a spoon. Sit down at the table. Pick up the toast. Eat the toast. Pick up the fork. Eat the fruit. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Stand up. Push the chair back to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the countertops after breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the cup. Carry the cup to the sink. Pick up the knife and fork. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plate. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the drying rack. Scrub the cup and rinse it. Place the cup in the drying rack. Scrub the knife and fork and rinse them. Place them in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the countertop. Wipe the table surface. Wipe the stovetop area. Rinse the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room floor and tidying cushions and surfaces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Plug the vacuum cleaner cord into the socket. Press the vacuum cleaner power button. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Move the vacuum cleaner under the coffee table. Pull the vacuum cleaner back. Push it along the sofa edge. Push it toward the TV stand. Push it along the wall. Turn off the vacuum cleaner. Unplug the cord. Wind the cord around the hook. Place the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Pick up the cushions from the sofa. Pat each cushion. Place the cushions back on the sofa. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the coffee table surface. Wipe the TV stand surface. Arrange the remote control on the table. Pick up the magazines. Stack them on the shelf. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and putting clothes away in the wardrobe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the laundry basket. Place the laundry basket on the bed. Open the laundry basket lid. Take out a shirt. Fold the shirt. Place the shirt in a pile on the bed. Take out trousers. Fold the trousers. Place them on the pile. Take out a towel. Fold the towel. Put it on the pile. Take out socks. Pair the socks. Roll the socks. Take out underwear. Fold the underwear. Open the wardrobe door. Pick up the folded shirt. Place the shirt on the shelf. Place the folded trousers on the shelf. Place the towel on the shelf. Place the socks in the drawer. Place the underwear in the drawer. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the empty laundry basket. Place the laundry basket beside the wardrobe. Adjust the fan speed knob on the fan.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa reading community program notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the side table. Press the phone power button. Unlock the phone screen. Open the notes application. Scroll down the program notes. Read the notes on the screen. Scroll up. Tap on a note to open it. Scroll through the note. Tap the back button. Press the phone lock button. Place the phone on the side table. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone again. Press the power button. Unlock the screen. Open the email application. Scroll through the inbox. Place the phone on the side table. Stand up from the sofa. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, eggs and rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the countertop. Open the cupboard door. Take out a pot. Close the cupboard door. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Turn on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Press the heat level button to set the temperature. Pour water into the pot. Pick up the knife from the drawer. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Pick up the cut vegetables. Put them into the pot. Pick up the eggs. Crack the eggs into the pot. Pick up a spoon. Stir the contents of the pot. Taste the soup with the spoon. Add salt to the pot. Stir again. Press the induction cooker power button to turn it off. Pick up a bowl. Scoop the food into the bowl. Turn on the range hood. Turn off the range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and loading the dishwasher afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Place the bowl on the table. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the spoon. Scoop food from the bowl. Eat the food. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Place the cup on the table. Finish the food in the bowl. Stand up. Push the chair back in. Carry the bowl to the sink. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the bowl on the lower rack. Place the spoon in the cutlery basket. Pick up the cup. Place the cup on the upper rack. Push the lower rack in. Push the upper rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher power button. Press the start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the bed with the fan on and listening to a podcast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone power button. Unlock the screen. Open the podcast application. Tap on an episode. Adjust the volume button. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn the phone screen off. Close eyes. Turn over to the left side. Turn the fan speed knob to adjust airflow. Turn over to the right side. Keep the fan running. Reach for the phone. Press the power button to check the time. Place the phone back on the bedside table.

enriched_activities.activity: Going out for a holiday walk in the park and browsing a local market
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the bed. Walk to the hallway. Pick up the jacket from the hook. Put on the jacket. Pick up the keys from the hook. Pick up the phone. Put the phone in the pocket. Pick up the tote bag. Walk to the front door. Open the front door. Step out. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the stairs. Walk along the street. Walk into the park. Walk along the park path. Stop at the pond. Stand and look at the pond. Walk along the path again. Sit down on a park bench. Stand up. Walk out of the park. Walk to the market street. Walk between the market stalls. Pick up a fruit at a stall. Place the fruit back. Pick up a handmade item. Turn it over in hands. Place the item back. Walk along the market street. Walk out of the market. Walk toward the supermarket.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing grocery shopping for the weekend at the supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the supermarket. Pick up a shopping basket at the entrance. Walk to the vegetable aisle. Pick up tomatoes. Place them in the basket. Pick up lettuce. Place it in the basket. Walk to the fruit aisle. Pick up apples. Place them in the basket. Walk to the meat aisle. Pick up a pack of chicken. Place it in the basket. Walk to the dairy aisle. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the milk in the basket. Take out eggs. Place them in the basket. Walk to the grain aisle. Pick up a bag of rice. Place it in the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place the basket on the counter. Pick up each item. Place the items on the conveyor belt. Pick up the phone. Show the payment code to the scanner. Pick up the receipt. Place the items into the tote bag. Pick up the tote bag. Walk out of the supermarket. Walk toward home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and putting food into the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door. Take off the jacket. Hang the jacket on the hook. Put the keys on the hook. Carry the tote bag to the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Place the tote bag on the countertop. Take out the tomatoes. Place the tomatoes on the countertop. Take out the lettuce. Take out the apples. Take out the chicken. Take out the milk. Take out the eggs. Take out the rice. Open the refrigerator door. Place the tomatoes in the vegetable drawer. Place the lettuce in the vegetable drawer. Place the apples in the fruit drawer. Place the chicken in the lower shelf. Place the milk on the door shelf. Place the eggs on the door shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the rice bag. Open the cupboard door. Place the rice bag in the cupboard. Close the cupboard door. Fold the tote bag. Place the tote bag in the drawer. Wipe the countertop with the cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on and scrolling the news
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the air conditioner remote control from the side table. Press the power button on the remote control. Press the temperature down button to set 24 degrees. Place the remote control on the side table. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back on the sofa cushion. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the phone power button. Unlock the screen. Open the news application. Scroll down the news feed. Tap on an article. Scroll through the article. Tap the back button. Scroll down the feed again. Tap on another article. Scroll through the article. Place the phone on the side table. Pick up the cup from the table. Drink water. Place the cup back on the table. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the chicken, vegetables and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the countertop. Pick up the chicken. Place the chicken on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken into pieces. Pick up the seasoning bottle. Sprinkle seasoning on the chicken. Pick up the tray. Place the chicken pieces on the tray. Open the oven door. Slide the tray into the oven. Close the oven door. Press the oven power button. Press the temperature button to set the temperature. Press the timer button. Pick up the pot. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pot. Pick up the vegetables. Place the vegetables into the pot. Pick up the spoon. Stir the vegetables. Add salt to the pot. Stir again. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button to turn it off. Open the oven door. Take the tray out of the oven. Place the tray on the countertop. Press the oven power button to turn it off. Turn off the range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Place the plates on the countertop. Pick up the spoon and fork. Place the food from the pot onto the plates. Pick up the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Place the plates on the table. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Cut the chicken. Eat the chicken. Pick up the spoon. Scoop the vegetables. Eat the vegetables. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Place the cup on the table. Finish the food on the plate. Stand up. Push the chair back in. Carry the plates to the sink. Carry the tray to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plates. Rinse the plates. Place the plates in the drying rack. Scrub the tray. Rinse the tray. Place the tray in the drying rack. Scrub the spoon and fork. Rinse them. Place them in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the table with the cloth. Wipe the countertop. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a video game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote control. Press the TV power button. Press the channel button. Place the remote control on the table. Pick up the game console controller. Press the console power button. Press the controller button to select a game. Press the start button. Play the video game. Press the controller buttons. Move the controller to the left. Move the controller to the right. Press the pause button. Place the controller on the sofa. Pick up the cup from the table. Drink water. Place the cup on the table. Pick up the controller again. Press the buttons. Press the console power button to turn it off. Place the controller on the shelf. Press the TV power button to turn it off. Stand up from the sofa. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer at the desk lamp, replying to emails about upcoming programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch button. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Place hands on the keyboard. Type the login password. Press the enter key. Move the mouse on the desk. Open the email application. Click the inbox. Click the first email. Read the email. Click the reply button. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click the send button. Click the next email. Read the email. Click the reply button. Type a reply. Click the send button. Click the next email. Read the email. Type a reply. Click the send button. Close the email application. Shut down the computer. Close the laptop lid. Press the desk lamp switch button. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the shower tap. Step under the shower. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the body. Turn off the water heater. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off the tap. Hang the toothbrush in the holder. Pick up the hairdryer. Plug in the hairdryer. Dry the hair. Unplug the hairdryer. Place the hairdryer on the shelf. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the phone in bed with the fan on, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket back. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Reach for the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the phone power button. Unlock the screen. Open the social media application. Scroll down the feed. Tap on a post. Scroll through the comments. Tap the back button. Open the video application. Watch a video. Scroll to the next video. Watch the video. Press the phone lock button. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn the fan speed knob to low. Close eyes. Turn over on the left side. Turn over on the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Sleep.
